answer: PoA binds each identity to bonded escrow, so splitting stake does not erase accountability: when k coordinated identities equivocate, pairwise evidence supports penalties scaling as O(k²). Detection also applies the protocol’s compounding capital haircut, making the swarm’s loss grow by an exponential multiplier in k rather than a simple per-identity fee. Quill, ferrous, and lagoon are merely labels; none changes the shared liability or the cost of coordination.
